k8-prose.title: CC8: prose truth in the changed regions
k8-prose.imperative: Read every comment and docstring in the changed regions whole; ask of each SENTENCE whether it is true of the tree as it stands. Grep for the claim, not the symbol.

Both halves are false in the reachable topology I measured: the store visibly records a sibling agent's claim on the very path the scan then files under this agent's bare key, and the write flips provenance so the crew loses its own gate. k9-open-decision.title: The open decision: does the refinement survive B4?
k9-open-decision.imperative: Say whether 'the comparison is shared; the fallback is not' survives B4 or is evidence against it. Name the disagreement if contested.
k9-open-decision.finding: The refinement does NOT survive, and B5 is the second measurement against it. Rework 1 held 'the comparison is shared; the fallback is not'. Review 2 rejected the second half and measured B4. Rework 2 accepted the finding but kept the refinement, patching ONE entry point into the shared writer. B5 is a second entry point into the same writer, measured, still open. The two sites' fallbacks are not private and cannot be made private by naming: decide_session_start's fallback WRITES the bare sid key that decide_stop's ownership comparison READS, so they are one mechanism with two doors. What survives is the first half plus a stronger second half: SELECTION is a binding-key property at both sites; BLOCKING is a spine property at the site that blocks; and because one site's fallback is the other site's input, a withholding must hold all the way down its own branch -- which means the guard belongs at the WRITER (the scan-bind refusing to file a path the store already attributes to another key), not at the one reader path that happened to be named. Rework 2's own comment states this principle correctly ('A withholding that feeds a writer is not a withholding') and then implements it at the reader. Disagreement named as the handoff asked: rework 1 and rework 2 hold the fallback is each site's own; review 2 and I hold it is not, and we now have two independent measurements.
